Jade (People Ops): FYI: rolling out two small policy tweaks effective 2026-04-15: Emergency Caregiver Leave (ECL) — up to 5 paid days in a rolling 12 months for urgent caregiver events; Volunteer Time Off (VTO) — 16 hours/year. Full policy: https://intranet.redwood.example/hr/policies/ecl-vto
Marcus (Finance): Do we need a payroll code to track ECL separately?
Kira (Legal): Yes. Treat as regular wages for tax; we'll advise regional tax notes. Recommend code ECL_PAY for tracking.
Jade (People Ops): Note: ECL is separate from PTO accruals, can be half-days, managers approve in HiBob within 48hrs (retrospective allowed). Emergency travel reimbursement cap raised to $2,000 per incident; receipts required; pre-approval for >$500.
Marcus (Finance): We'll update expense categories and Concur mappings. Corporate card can be used when available.
people-ops-bot: Policy doc updated: "Emergency Caregiver Leave & Volunteer Time Off" https://intranet.redwood.example/hr/policies/ecl-vto (effective 2026-04-15)
Jade (People Ops): We'll run two 30-min manager drop-in trainings; FAQ to follow. DM #people-ops with questions.
